title: A uniform variable-width SAT algorithm for small satisfying weak backdoors
claims: SmallWeakBackdoorVariableWidthSATInP uses one polynomial-time machine for the stated promise, with the width parameter allowed to vary by encoded formula.
ConstantWeakBackdoorSATInP proves an unbounded-width corollary for each fixed bound on the size of a satisfying weak 2-CNF backdoor.
P_subset_NP is separately checked against the exact pinned definitions.
